title: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who, in a flashback, is fatally wounded by Heliod after slaying Xenagos, and who now arrives on New Capenna searching for a place to call home.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker and Elspeth's friend, who carries her out of the Temple of the Gods; Elspeth recalls he told her New Capenna was home.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The god who stabs Elspeth with the spear Godsend for making a deal with Erebos.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The God of the Dead and Heliod's sworn enemy, with whom Elspeth made a deal to bring back Daxos.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A foe Elspeth and Ajani fought and slew at Nyx.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Elspeth's lost love whom she tried to bring back.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: The aging former assassin who leads the Maestros from his museum in Park Heights, a lover of fashion and ancient texts.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: A vampire, Xander's right hand and Deacon, sent to spy on the Cabaretti in the Mezzio.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: The horned, leonin head of the Cabaretti, a wealthy and jovial grandfather of the family and Jinnie's adoptive father.

entities.name: Jinnie Fay
entities.description: Jetmir's adoptive daughter, who plans the Crescendo and speaks of changing the plane with the Font.

entities.name: Kitt
entities.description: A furred-eared singer and friend of Jinnie.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A teenager in Jetmir's care who lacks only her leave to go.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker seeking a place of harmony between nature and the constructed world, haunted by Skalla.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker with clanking metal in a wide-brimmed hat, working for Urabrask, who meets Vivien in the Caldaia.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A figure Tezzeret works for and wants Vivien to meet, said to be on the side of freedom.

entities.name: Ziatora
entities.description: A dragon and orator of the Riveteers who rallies workers against the other families.

entities.name: The Adversary
entities.description: A shadowy upstart gaining power by promising Halo and siphoning from the Maestros.

entities.name: Muri
entities.description: Jinnie's cat familiar.

entities.name: Regis
entities.description: Jinnie's dog familiar.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: One of the five families, led by Xander, which has held influence for a long time.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: The family of celebration led by Jetmir, preparing the Crescendo and the Font.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: The family of workers and builders in the Caldaia led by Ziatora.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: The family said to impose themselves on Riveteer streets.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: The family that specializes in illusions, distractions, and manipulations.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A city of steel and gilded lines, ruled by five families, shielded by an ancient barrier from a ruined plane.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The heavenly upper level with terraced gardens and Xander's museum.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The bustling midtown steeped in crime, opportunity and the Cabaretti.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: The utilitarian lowest level of the city, reimagined by Ziatora and her Riveteers.

entities.name: Vantoleone
entities.description: The Cabaretti hall with a dance floor and Jetmir's office.

entities.name: Temple of the Gods
entities.description: The divine temple in Nyx where Heliod wounded Elspeth.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Elspeth is wounded.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: The iridescent magical substance sustaining power and life in New Capenna, with a dwindling source.

entities.name: The Font
entities.description: A secret source of Halo known only to the Cabaretti's inner council, to be revealed at the Crescendo.

entities.name: Crescendo
entities.description: A great Cabaretti celebration being prepared.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: Elspeth's weapon, found as a sword and transformed by Heliod into a spear.

events.summary: In a flashback, Heliod runs Elspeth through with Godsend and orders Ajani to carry her to Erebos.
events.quote: "Carry her back to the mortal realm, leonin. Deliver her to Erebos,"

events.summary: Ajani carries the dying Elspeth to Theros, then leaves to find help as she sees a flash of light cleaving the heavens.
events.quote: The last thing she saw was a flash of light, cleaving the heavens in two.

events.summary: Xander measures Anhelo for a new outfit and shares worries about Halo supply.
events.quote: "The balance of power in this town is shifting."

events.summary: Xander orders Anhelo to secretly learn about the Cabaretti's rumored new Halo supply in the Mezzio.
events.quote: gather the information on what this source is by whatever means necessary.

events.summary: Xander retreats to a hidden room of ancient texts on New Capenna's founding.
events.quote: Statues of winged angels were locked in stony prayer

events.summary: Jinnie and Jetmir plan the Crescendo and discuss the Adversary and the Font.
events.quote: "Besides, the moment the Font is revealed, everything in New Capenna will change and the Cabaretti will be on top."

events.summary: Jinnie tells Giada and Kitt that they are going to change the plane.
events.quote: "Good, because in no time at all, we're going to change the plane."

events.summary: Vivien explores New Capenna's lower levels and finds a synthetic city out of balance.
events.quote: Nature might exist here, but it wasn't real.

events.summary: Ziatora addresses an assembly of workers, attacking the Cabaretti, Brokers and Obscura.
events.quote: "The Cabaretti demand too much for this Crescendo without spreading its benefits.

events.summary: Vivien recognizes a stranger as a planeswalker, who leads her out of the hall.
Tezzeret tells Vivien that others like them are present and that his employer is acquiring Halo with other goals, and invites her to meet Urabrask.
events.quote: "Good, come along then. Urabrask will be eager to meet you."

events.summary: Vivien confronts Tezzeret, recalling that they fought on opposite sides in the War of the Spark, and refuses his orders.
events.quote: They'd fought on opposite sides during the War of the Spark

events.summary: Elspeth arrives in New Capenna, wondering whether this is the home Ajani said it would be.
events.quote: "Home," Elspeth murmured, seeing if the word fit New Capenna when said aloud.

relations.quote: Erebos, God of the Dead and Heliod's sworn enemy

relations.note: inflicts the mortal wound with Godsend
relations.quote: With a twist, Heliod withdrew Godsend
Her friend had never lied to her

relations.note: his loyal Deacon and right hand
relations.quote: All Xander required of his Deacon was loyalty.
"And that is why you run this town."

relations.note: wealthy head and grandfather of the family
relations.quote: before he was the wealthy head of the Cabaretti
But that was what fathers were supposed to do, even the adoptive kind.
reimagined in its ghastly fashion by Ziatora and her Riveteers

relations.note: fought on opposite sides in the War of the Spark
relations.quote: They'd fought on opposite sides during the War of the Spark

relations.note: says Urabrask is on their side
relations.quote: The man I'm currently working for is in the process of acquiring it.
